solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Blue waste material about to be returned to tall building

parts.note: the blue is the sky overhead
scrap is waste material

indicators.note: returned means the word for about is turned round and read backwards

parts.note: re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: A recycling instruction: blue waste material is to be returned to a tower block.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to be returned' turns RE into ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A skyscraper is a very tall city building, the tall building being described.

clue.text: Wild one of magi protected Virginia

indicators.note: protected shows the wise man's word surrounds the state abbreviation

parts.note: the magi were wise men, and a sage is a wise man
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

explanation.surface: A wild Magus guarding the state of Virginia.
explanation.walkthrough: The Magi were the three wise men who visited the infant Jesus, so 'one of magi' is a wise man; 'protected' wraps him round the state.
explanation.definitionFit: Savage means fierce and untamed, a synonym of wild.

clue.text: Drew key Dan forged

indicators.note: forged means made up or counterfeited, signalling a rearrangement of key and Dan

explanation.surface: A man named Dan forging a key, perhaps a locksmith or a burglar.
explanation.definitionFit: To yank is to pull sharply, and drew means pulled.

clue.text: Out-of-town ball?

parts.note: not a football kicked outside the town but a dance held in the rural shires

explanation.definitionFit: A country dance is a traditional folk dance, a ball held out in rural areas.

clue.text: Nearly everything thus as well

indicators.note: nearly means not quite all of it, so the last letter is dropped

parts.note: all means everything
so means thus

explanation.surface: Almost everything in this way, too.
explanation.definitionFit: Also means in addition, the same as as well.

clue.text: All over each point at this place

parts.note: every means each
W is a compass point, west
here means at this place

explanation.surface: Every point here, all over the place.
explanation.walkthrough: A point is often a compass point: N, S, E or W.
explanation.definitionFit: Everywhere means in all places, all over.

clue.text: Out, say? Standing out

indicators.note: say signals that the word is spoken, giving a word that sounds like it

parts.note: in cricket a batter who is bowled is out

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about the word out, then a remark about standing out.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a batter is out when bowled; said aloud BOWLED sounds like BOLD.
explanation.definitionFit: Bold colours or lettering are conspicuous, standing out from their background.

clue.text: Round with park officer at end of day in greenhouse

parts.note: O is round in shape
a ranger is an official who looks after a park

indicators.note: end of asks for the last letter of day

explanation.surface: A park ranger doing a round of the greenhouse at the end of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: An orangery is a glasshouse originally used to grow orange trees, a greenhouse.

clue.text: Frenzied evil spirit has the first clue

parts.note: a demon is an evil spirit
the first clue in a crossword is 1 across, written as 1 (I) and AC

explanation.surface: A frenzied demon holding the first clue to some mystery.
explanation.walkthrough: Crossword self-reference: the first clue is 1 Across, written with I for one and AC for across.
explanation.definitionFit: Demoniac means wildly frenzied, as if possessed by a demon.

clue.text: Vehicle the lady put in pound was crushed

parts.note: a van is a vehicle

indicators.note: put in tells us the pronoun is placed inside the slang word for pound

parts.note: quid is slang for a pound sterling
she is the pronoun for a lady

explanation.surface: A woman's car is impounded and then crushed by the authorities.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put in' puts the lady inside the pound. A QUID is British slang for a pound sterling; 'was' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Vanquished means defeated utterly, a synonym for crushed in the sense of overwhelmed.

clue.text: Cultivate land, distant meadow first

parts.note: far means distant

indicators.note: first asks for the opening letter of meadow

explanation.surface: Advice to a farmer about which distant meadow to cultivate first.
explanation.definitionFit: To farm is to work the land, growing crops on it.

clue.text: Passage to Scottish island learner took was temporary

parts.note: transit is passage from one place to another
Iona is an island in the Inner Hebrides
L is for learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car

explanation.surface: A learner driver's temporary trip to an island off Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: IONA is an island off the west coast of Scotland; L is from the L-plates British learner drivers must show.
explanation.definitionFit: Transitional means belonging to a passing phase of change, so temporary.

clue.text: Reach hospital in slum area

indicators.note: in shows the hospital letter goes inside the phrase meaning reach

parts.note: to reach a place is to get to it
H is the abbreviation for hospital on maps and signs

explanation.surface: Getting to a hospital in a deprived neighbourhood.
explanation.definitionFit: A ghetto is a poor, crowded quarter of a city, a slum district.

clue.text: Hotel with lowdown on gas

parts.note: a hydro is a hotel offering spa treatments, originally hydropathic
gen is British slang for information, the lowdown

explanation.surface: A hotel guest getting inside information about a gas leak.
explanation.walkthrough: Hotel is not the NATO H here: a HYDRO is a British spa hotel. GEN is British slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: Hydrogen is the lightest chemical element, a colourless gas.

clue.text: Claret's served in enemy living quarters

indicators.note: in places the rearranged wine inside the word for enemy

parts.note: a foe is an enemy

indicators.note: served suggests the wine is dished up, so its letters are reworked

parts.note: claret's here gives the letters of claret plus s

explanation.surface: Wine served to the enemy in the barracks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'served' rearranges CLARETS to RECASTL, and 'in' places that inside the enemy. The forecastle (fo'c'sle) is a ship's forward crew quarters.
explanation.definitionFit: The forecastle is the front part of a ship where the crew have their living quarters.

clue.text: Thinking ill of oneself?

parts.note: not low self-esteem but constantly believing one is sick

explanation.definitionFit: Hypochondria is the anxious belief that one has an illness, literally imagining oneself ill.

clue.text: Pretended to be moved emotionally

definitions.meaning: ... in the sense of feigned, as an ... accent
... in the sense of touched or stirred by feeling

explanation.definitionFit: Affected means both put on as a pretence and stirred by emotion.

clue.text: Officer's material not English

indicators.note: not tells us the English letter is left out

parts.note: corporeal means material, bodily

explanation.surface: The fabric an officer's uniform is made of is not English.
explanation.definitionFit: A corporal is a non-commissioned officer in the army.

clue.text: From 10 across, foie gras or soft cheese

indicators.note: from signals that the answer is made out of these letters, rearranged

parts.note: the answer to 10 across, meaning cultivate land

explanation.surface: Choosing between farm produce: foie gras or a soft cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: 'From' says the letters of FARM plus FOIE GRAS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Fromage frais is a smooth, soft fresh cheese from France.

clue.text: Brave coming from Jericho without Juliet

indicators.note: coming from suggests a new word made out of these letters
without means the J is taken off Jericho

parts.note: Juliet is the NATO alphabet code word for J

explanation.surface: A brave figure coming from the ancient city of Jericho, without his Juliet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without Juliet' cuts Jericho to ERICHO, which 'coming from' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Heroic means showing great courage, so it is a synonym of brave.

clue.text: Not accustomed to being unemployed?

definitions.meaning: ... in the sense of not put to work, playfully applied to a person

explanation.definitionFit: Unused means both unfamiliar with something and not employed or put to use.

clue.text: Inescapable revolutionary avoiding awkward ban for principal

indicators.note: revolutionary hints at overturning, so the letters of inescapable are turned about

parts.note: taken as written, the letters removed from the pool

explanation.surface: An inescapable revolutionary dodging an awkward ban.
explanation.walkthrough: 'avoiding awkward' removes the letters of BAN, jumbled, from INESCAPABLE; 'revolutionary' rearranges the remaining eight letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Especial is an old-fashioned word for special or chief, so principal in sense.

clue.text: Pig and strangely one that flies

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: strangely signals that the letters of one are rearranged

explanation.surface: A pig, and strangely one that can fly, as in pigs might fly.
explanation.definitionFit: A pigeon is a bird, so it is a creature that flies.

clue.text: Old friend's a gem

parts.note: a pal is a friend

explanation.surface: An old friend described affectionately as a gem.
explanation.definitionFit: An opal is an iridescent gemstone.

clue.text: One bird or another with bit missing

indicators.note: missing shows the word bit is taken away from the other bird

parts.note: another bird: the bittern is a wading heron
taken as written

explanation.surface: One bird, or another one with a piece missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another bird, BITTERN; with 'bit missing' it loses BIT.
explanation.definitionFit: The tern is a seabird, so it is one bird.

clue.text: Amazing send-up, to us transforming

indicators.note: transforming signals that the letters of send-up to us are changed into a new order

explanation.surface: A parody being made of us, and changing us amazingly.
explanation.definitionFit: Stupendous means astonishingly great, a synonym of amazing.

clue.text: Make officer a blockhead

parts.note: to do something is to make it
Lt is the abbreviation for lieutenant, an officer

explanation.surface: An order to promote a fool to officer.
explanation.definitionFit: A dolt is a stupid person, a blockhead.

clue.text: Spring put in a good position

parts.note: a well is a spring of water
placed means put

explanation.surface: A spring of water situated in a favourable spot.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-placed means advantageously situated, in a good position.
